theorems.statement: ∀ (S : Type) [CommRing S] (J : Ideal S) (A : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{0}) (f : Quiver.Hom A (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of S))), GoodReductionJacobian.AbelianSchemePropertyBundle S f → (∀ s : ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of S)), topologicalKrullDim ↥(f.base ⁻¹' {s}) = 2) → let β := AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)); let p := CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.snd f β; GoodReductionJacobian.AbelianSchemePropertyBundle (S ⧸ J) p ∧ (∀ t : ↥(AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of (S ⧸ J))), topologicalKrullDim ↥(p.base ⁻¹' {t}) = 2)
